name: Reanimation Protocols
text: At the end of your Command phase, roll a D3 for each of your units with this ability. For each point rolled, one at a time: if a model in the unit is wounded, it recovers 1 wound; otherwise, if the unit has lost models, one returns to the board with 1 wound remaining.

name: Implacable Resilience
text: Each attack that is allocated to this model has its Damage characteristic reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1.

name: Plasmacyte
text: The unit carries one plasmacyte. Once per battle for each plasmacyte carried, when the unit is selected to fight, you may spend one: until the end of the phase, its melee weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
